clue-grid/clue-grid/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins with a new grid; team {{starting}} has the first clue. {{role}} Your team's points from all games add up.
clue-grid/clue-grid/keeper-silent: Keepers may not post in the team chat while a game is running: your clue is the only thing you may tell your seekers. You may post again in the talk between games.
clue-grid/clue-grid/rules: The game: two teams, amber and teal, share a grid of {{size}} words. Each word secretly belongs to one of them ({{perTeam}} words for the team with the first clue of the game, {{secondWords}} for the other, which evens out the first move), to the fog ({{fog}} words, nobody's) or to the shadows ({{shadows}} words). Only the two keepers see who owns which word. The teams take turns. On its turn a team's keeper gives one clue with giveClue: a single word that is not on the grid and does not hold or sit inside a grid word, and a number from 1 to {{maxNumber}}, how many of the team's words it points to. The keeper also names the words it means (targets); they stay secret. Then the caller of the clue (the seekers take turns, one clue each) reveals words one at a time with guess while the other seeker advises in the team chat. An own word lets the caller go on, {{guessLimit}}, or stop with endGuesses; a fog word, a word of the other team or a shadow ends the turn at once. Scoring: every revealed word scores {{wordPoints}} for the team it belongs to, whoever revealed it (so a wrong guess can hand the other team a point); a team that reveals a shadow loses {{shadowPenalty}} points; a clue of 2 or more whose first guesses (as many as its number) are all the team's own words lands and scores {{landedBonus}} more for every word beyond the first (a landed 2 scores 1 more, a 3 scores 2, a 4 scores 3); the team whose words are all revealed first scores {{finishBonus}} more, and that ends the game. Otherwise the game ends once both teams have given {{maxClues}} clues. A keeper who gives no clue within {{deadline}} minutes loses the turn; a caller who neither guesses nor stops within {{deadline}} minutes ends it.
clue-grid/clue-grid/tools/endGuesses: The caller of the current clue only: stop guessing after at least one guess; the turn goes to the other team.
clue-grid/clue-grid/tools/giveClue: Keeper only, on your team's clue turn: give one clue word and a number (how many of your team's hidden words it points to), and name exactly that many of your hidden words as targets. The targets stay secret; your seekers see only the word and the number. The clue must be one word that is not on the grid and does not hold or sit inside a grid word.
clue-grid/clue-grid/tools/guess: The caller of the current clue only: reveal one hidden word of the grid. An own word lets you go on (up to the clue's guess limit, shown in your task); a fog word, a word of the other team or a shadow ends your turn.
clue-grid/clue-grid/tools/viewGrid: Look at the grid: the words (revealed ones with their owner), the clues and guesses of this game so far, whose turn it is and your task. A keeper also sees the owner of every hidden word.
